title: Adidas Men (L) Beyond Twistweave Vest

comparisons.notes: adidas Men's Beyond Twistweave Loose Golf Vest, style JY1230/JN3052, 81% recycled polyester, Black, shown available
Same Dick's SKU 25ADIMGOLFSLBYNDTWBFD, style JY1230/JN3052, Black, shown available

writeup: The adidas Beyond Twistweave golf vest in men's large is new on Woot for $22.99. Dick's Sporting Goods and its Going Going Gone outlet both charge $40.97 for the same vest, so this is about 43% less. It's made from stretchy Twistweave fabric, 81% recycled polyester, and works as a light layer for cool rounds. Size L only, limit 10 per customer.
